title: Qwen3-30B-A3B pinned WikiText perplexity parity gate
decision: pass the registered canonical F32-activation relative-perplexity gate; retain the production-mode result as a failed diagnostic

corpus.preprocessing: DuckDB 1.5.4 reads the text column in Parquet row order; CRLF and CR normalize to LF; all 4358 rows join with one LF

tokenization.reason: avoid applying the current whole-segment BPE implementation to all 1.29 MB before truncating
tokenization.procedure: verify the full derived-file SHA-256, encode newline-terminated segments in order until the declared token count is reached, then truncate

sampling.description: each fresh 32-token context scores its immediately following corpus token from the final-logit row

harness.registered_activation_mode: F32 canonical expert-activation reference on CPU and the hybrid CPU tier
harness.privacy: only aggregate losses, timings, bounded counts, paths, and hashes are retained; corpus text and token IDs are not logged

production_mode_diagnostic.classification: diagnostic only; not substituted for the pre-registered canonical gate
production_mode_diagnostic.activation_mode: production quantized CPU activations for all CPU-executed experts
production_mode_diagnostic.interpretation: the hybrid scalar is lower, not a demonstrated quality loss, but the absolute parity threshold fails because production CPU and hybrid execute different proportions of experts through the existing quantized CPU-activation path

controls.profile: 33 tokens, one endpoint, production boundary-band CPU
33 tokens, one endpoint, zero-epsilon exact-router CPU
controls.status: pass; identical to the production boundary-band CPU control

resolved_operational_issue.root_cause: the first evaluator tokenized the complete 1.29 MB corpus as one segment before applying max_tokens, so bounded scoring attempts spent their timeout in tokenizer work and never reached a scalar
resolved_operational_issue.repair: hash the complete file, then tokenize deterministic newline-terminated prefix segments only until max_tokens is satisfied
resolved_operational_issue.evidence: the 33-token control reached its first scoring window and completed in 7.63 seconds; the registered 1025-token paired run then completed both scalars
